name: Kindle Paperwhite (2nd gen)
description: Kindle Paperwhite (2nd gen), 758x1024 16-level greyscale e-reader running KOReader with the Tesserae plugin. Needs a jailbreak to install KOReader.
notes_md: Awaiting confirmed test on real hardware with the Tesserae plugin. The same unit is confirmed through KOReader's TRMNL plugin (trmnl_png). Runs the Tesserae KOReader plugin (dmellok/tesserae-koreader) on a jailbroken Kindle. Pair from Tools -> Tesserae with a claim code; the plugin reports the real screen size, so this entry only fixes the default panel and the store listing.
